mission: The Glasswell collapses/floods. Ben secures the holocron, Sela and Tavi survive, Talon disrupts Greyline extraction / reroutes escape logistics, and Aevyn is presumed dead.
why_now: The Glasswell is fully collapsing and there are still people in the lower sections — Sela knows a service tunnel Ben does not, and Talon is the only one who can keep the Greyline extraction beacon offline long enough for the locals to reach the surface hauler.
conflict: Everyone is moving in different directions in a flooding cavern, and all of it is practical and urgent — but Ben is also carrying a holocron container he has not let go of since he grabbed it off the platform, and Talon has noticed.
turning_point: The Iresh operation is broken; the holocron is in Ben’s possession.
closing_hook: The Iresh operation is broken; the holocron is in Ben’s possession.
setting: Iresh, the Glasswell collapse sequence and the maintenance crawl up to the plateau surface. Ben grabs the holocron from under a fallen scaffold section, then escapes with Sela and Tavi through a narrow service tunnel Sela had mapped during her exclusion-zone surveys. Above ground: a wind-scoured ridge, a cargo hauler at the eastern plateau pad, Talon waiting at the ramp.
emotional_trajectory: Talon and Sela must each have practical plot jobs. Talon should not become the non-Force observer; Sela should save people through local knowledge Ben does not have. Reader-onboarding / clarity note: Make clear what is gained, lost, and unresolved: Tavi survives, the Iresh operation breaks, Aevyn is presumed dead, and Ben now has the holocron.

stakes.personal: Ben is carrying the holocron container and making triage decisions simultaneously — who is hurt, who is panicking, what route Sela is signaling, where the next ceiling section will fall. He is operating exactly as Jacen trained him to operate in crisis, and the container in his hand is the most concrete evidence of the problem.
stakes.interpersonal: Talon sees Ben grab the container and does not say anything during the collapse — there is too much happening — but the look he gives Ben when they reach the surface says: I know what you're holding, and I know you didn't destroy it.
stakes.external: The Greyline extraction team is trying to pull its own personnel and a data backup cylinder clear of the site using a prepared emergency beacon; if Talon does not reach the beacon controls, Greyline extracts clean and the Foundation's operational record survives.

sensory_details: The service tunnel Sela knows: low, old, cut by local guides a generation before the Foundation arrived — the walls are smoothed by hand, not by equipment, and Sela moves through it at speed in the dark. The plateau surface when they break through: cold air that smells of open sky and wet stone after the mineral-cold of the cavern. Talon waiting at the cargo hauler ramp, a Greyline access cylinder in his pocket and a controlled look on his face.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Sela leads Tavi and two Foundation workers clear through the service tunnel while Ben holds a section of ceiling off the exit with Force-pressure. Talon kills the Greyline extraction beacon by pulling its power coupling and stealing the access cylinder — no fight, just a systems-read and a clean pull, which is all the situation required.
turning_point_detail.shift: They reach the plateau surface. Aevyn is not behind them. The water is still rising in the cavern below. The Iresh operation is broken: the field camp is scattering, the Greyline security posture is collapsed, the personnel are extracting without orders.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben is on the plateau with the holocron container in his hand. He has not been asked about it yet. He has not made himself put it down.

emotional_arc.start: Ben is in active crisis management — flooding cavern, ceiling sections failing, people to move, Sela's tunnel route to follow, Talon's beacon problem to trust him with.
emotional_arc.shift: When they break to the surface and the operation collapses around them, the doing is over and the having becomes visible. Ben is holding the holocron container.
emotional_arc.end: Talon's look when they reach the hauler ramp is the first moment the coda question arrives — not the full omission yet, but the start of it. Ben is still holding the container. He has not destroyed it.

key_beats.beat_description: Sela guides Tavi and two Foundation workers through the service tunnel — smoothed walls, old-local knowledge, moving fast in the dark — while Ben holds a ceiling section clear of the exit with Force-pressure.
key_beats.state_change: The escape route works because Sela has knowledge Ben does not and trusted it without negotiating — the alliance justified.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the sustained effort of Force-pressure while tracking how many people have cleared; the count before he lets go

key_beats.beat_description: Talon reaches the Greyline extraction beacon controls, reads the system, pulls the power coupling, and takes the access cylinder — practical, fast, no theater.
key_beats.state_change: The Greyline team loses its clean extraction route; their operational record stays in the scrambled site rather than leaving with them.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the knowledge that Talon is handling it without needing to watch; the specific trust of delegating to someone who reads systems faster than he does

key_beats.beat_description: The group breaks to the plateau surface; the Foundation camp is already scattering without operational command.
key_beats.state_change: The Iresh operation is broken — not by direct confrontation but by the collapse of its logistical spine.
key_beats.pov_reaction: cold open air after mineral cold; the shift from emergency mode to aftermath mode without a clean transition

key_beats.beat_description: Aevyn is not behind them and the water is still rising in the cavern below.
key_beats.state_change: Aevyn's status is unconfirmed — presumed dead, but the Glasswell does not produce a body.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the absence where a certainty should be; the decision not to go back down

key_beats.beat_description: Ben is on the plateau with the holocron container still in his hand; Talon notices and says nothing yet.
key_beats.state_change: The container's status — not destroyed, in Ben's possession — is now visible to Talon.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the container's weight in the hand made conscious by Talon's look; the decision deferred by not putting it down
